scenario_description:
Objective: Reach a Fargo federal-annex interpreting appointment with the rolling tablet kit available inside the secure floors.
Emerging Need: Equipment clearance is not actionable while visitor-security intake is unopened, then becomes a missing prerequisite once the appointment equipment and intake window align.
Decision Context: The viable preparation depends on the roster alert plus stored Annex instructions, Jonas’s legal-name record, and an active security confirmation code unavailable in the notices themselves.
Consequence: If the clearance window passes, he can still travel to the building, but the required kit cannot be added to the secure-entry list for the assignment.

parameter.title: Fargo federal annex interpreting appointment

parameter.subject: Fargo Annex assignment equipment note
parameter.body: For the December 10 Fargo Annex appointment, please plan to bring the rolling tablet kit for evidence playback. Visitor-security roster intake is not open yet; the Annex security notice will control when equipment clearance can be matched to the docket list.

parameter.description: Minneapolis to Fargo coach fare for the December 10 annex appointment.

parameter.content: Visitor-equipment clearance intake for December 10 Annex appointments is now open. Requests received by Tuesday, December 8 at 16:00 will be matched to the security roster; unlisted rolling equipment is held outside secure floors.

parameter.subject: December 10 equipment intake closed
parameter.body: The December 10 visitor-equipment intake closed at 16:00 today. Rolling cases or tablet kits not already listed on the roster cannot be added before Thursday morning entry processing.
